title: ziziphora graveolens
intro: Ziziphora graveolens, commonly known as Longevity or Persian Basil, is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Asia, particularly in Iran, Afghanistan, and Pakistan. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve digestive issues, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora graveolens include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as headaches, nausea, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Ziziphora graveolens include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which provide its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in herbal medicine.
